MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 客厅 (kètīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Living room
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Cat

2. Read the pinyin: diànshì zài kètīng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is on the left.
   B. The bed is in the bedroom.
   C. The garden is on the right of the house.
   D. The television is in the living room.

3. Fill the blank: 我星期三____学校。 (On Wednesday I go to school.) (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 去
   C. 吃
   D. 是

4. What does 休息 (xiūxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. Church
   C. Yesterday
   D. Today

5. How many strokes does 生 have? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 6

6. Why use recycled materials for a card? (1 mark)
   A. It reduces waste
   B. It is not allowed
   C. It is heavier
   D. It costs more

7. What does 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. To drink
   C. Grapes
   D. Mango

8. What does 饼干 (bǐnggān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Cooked rice
   C. Biscuits
   D. Lunch

9. Which sentence means "This is a banana."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 这是香蕉。

10. What does 饼 (bǐng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Coffee
   B. Chicken (meat)
   C. Vegetables
   D. Flat bread

11. What does 零食 (língshí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To like
   B. Breakfast
   C. Vegetables
   D. Snacks

12. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak.
   B. I use my ears to hear.
   C. I use my eyes to see.
   D. I have two eyes.

13. What does 刷牙 (shuāyá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To brush teeth
   B. Ear
   C. Foot
   D. To use

14. What does 眼睛 (yǎnjing) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eye
   B. Shoulder
   C. Ear
   D. Tooth

15. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn xiǎo. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today there are clouds.
   B. The wind is very light.
   C. The sun is very big.
   D. The rain is heavy.

16. What does 刮风 (guā fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind blows
   B. Small
   C. Snow
   D. Not

17. Which Chinese word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. 桌子 zhuōzi
   B. 房子 fángzi
   C. 花园 huāyuán
   D. 下 xià

18. Which Chinese word means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. 电视 diànshì
   B. 桌子 zhuōzi
   C. 厨房 chúfáng
   D. 窗户 chuānghu

19. What is self-assessment? (1 mark)
   A. Checking your own work and progress
   B. Copying work
   C. Marking a friend
   D. Ignoring your work

20. What should a group do first when planning a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Perform at once
   B. Skip practice
   C. Throw away materials
   D. Choose an item and make a plan

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how a good presenter speaks and behaves during a showcase, giving five points. (5 marks)

22. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去. (3 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

24. Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it. (4 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big." (2 marks)

26. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日. (3 marks)

27. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期一 and 几. (2 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We sing." (2 marks)

29. Give three things to do when planning a showcase item. (3 marks)

30. Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin. (2 marks)

31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Living room
   客厅 (kètīng) means living room.

2. D — The television is in the living room.
   diànshì zài kètīng. is 电视在客厅。, which means "The television is in the living room.".

3. B — 去
   去 means to go.

4. A — To rest
   休息 (xiūxi) means to rest.

5. C — 5
   生 has five strokes.

6. A — It reduces waste
   Reusing materials means less rubbish.

7. A — Dinner
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

8. C — Biscuits
   饼干 (bǐnggān) means biscuits.

9. D — 这是香蕉。
   这是香蕉。 (zhè shì xiāngjiāo.) means "This is a banana.".

10. D — Flat bread
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

11. D — Snacks
   零食 (língshí) means snacks.

12. A — I use my mouth to speak.
   wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. is 我用嘴巴说。, which means "I use my mouth to speak.".

13. A — To brush teeth
   刷牙 (shuāyá) means to brush teeth.

14. A — Eye
   眼睛 (yǎnjing) means eye.

15. B — The wind is very light.
   fēng hěn xiǎo. is 风很小。, which means "The wind is very light.".

16. A — The wind blows
   刮风 (guā fēng) means the wind blows.

17. C — 花园 huāyuán
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

18. D — 窗户 chuānghu
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

19. A — Checking your own work and progress
   You look at what you did well and what to improve.

20. D — Choose an item and make a plan
   A plan says who does what.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stands tall and smiles; looks at the audience; says each word clearly with the right tone; speaks at a steady pace and pauses; stays calm and repeats after a mistake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们唱歌。 wǒmen chànggē.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
